apps.name: Warlords Classic Strategy (paid app)
apps.localizedDescription:
Warlords Classic is an official port of the fabulous game you have been playing in your childhood on PC, Mac or Amiga computers. Now it's available on your iPad and iPhone! Enjoy old-school graphics, old-time map and factions! Recall great memories!

• 3 free maps: Illuria, Erythea and Reldaria.
• 60 more maps are available via in-app purchase: Isladia, Krilantis, Rushington, Tribera, Seven Kingdoms, Esesgee Isle, Africa, Europe, Fopruedor, Ubria, The Maze, Costa Calma, Dragon Realms, Hadesha, Eneria, Hand of Fate, Arthurian Britain and more...
• Multiplayer via Game Center is available now!!!

Join us on FaceBook:  http://www.facebook.com/WarlordsGame

Join the war to conquer Illuria in this classic war lords fantasy strategy game
